name: greeter-api
description: A single-endpoint Go HTTP service: GET /hello?name=X returns a JSON greeting formatted exactly as "Hello, X!". A missing name is rejected as an error, never defaulted. Stateless — no database, no auth, no other components. Built to the app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference Go conventions: net/http standard library, cmd/greeter-api/main.go entrypoint, internal/ packages, JSON errors shaped {"error": "message"}.
